notes.text:
An update is available for kernel-rt.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The kernel-rt packages provide the Real Time Linux Kernel, which enables fine-tuning for systems with extremely high determinism requirements.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: proc: protect ptrace_may_access() with exec_update_lock (FD links) (CVE-2026-64375)

* kernel: Bluetooth: bpa10x: avoid OOB read of revision string in bpa10x_setup() (CVE-2026-64549)

* kernel: wifi: mwifiex: bound uAP association event IEs to the event buffer (CVE-2026-68326)

* kernel: wifi: mac80211: validate extension-frame layout before RX (CVE-2026-68470)

* kernel: net/smc: fix socket use-after-free during link group termination (CVE-2026-74493)

* kernel: wifi: mwifiex: use the subframe length when parsing A-MSDU TDLS frames (CVE-2026-74488)

* kernel: net: smc: fix splice entry lifetime imbalance in smc_rx_splice (CVE-2026-74631)

* kernel: perf/core: Fix group leader use-after-free after sibling detach (CVE-2026-74637)

* kernel: nvdimm/btt: reject an arena whose nfree is below the lane count (CVE-2026-89965)

* kernel: slip: remove slip_hangup() to fix use-after-free in slip_receive_buf() (CVE-2026-90057)

* kernel: scsi: qla2xxx: Unlink NVMe unsol ctx before freeing on LS reject error (CVE-2026-97528)

* kernel: RDMA/siw: Bound fragmented header copies by the remaining length (CVE-2026-98323)

* kernel: cipso: adjust cached option offsets when removing CIPSO (CVE-2026-99064)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [Rocky Linux-8] The slab cache entries for gfs2 and dlm grow very large for gfs2 filesystems (JIRA:Rocky Linux-220529)

* XFS NULL pointer dereference in xfs_inode_mark_reclaimable due to race in xfs_free_perag during umount (JIRA:Rocky Linux-247835)

* kprobe/ftrace: use-after-free and panic after ftrace_kill(), needs backport of 1a7d0890dd4a and e113f0b46d19 (JIRA:Rocky Linux-284885)

* Critical Bug Fixes for customer issues with lpfc [rhel-8.10.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-286158)

* Backport CVEs from v7.2 [rhel-8.10.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-300371)

* Fix crasher in gss_unwrap_resp_integ() (JIRA:Rocky Linux-309171)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
